recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No follow-up is needed in core unless the CDS work group reopens the later request-only policy for ActivityDefinition.kind.
issue_request: FHIR-15872 was a Published CDS change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that ActivityDefinition.kind no longer bind to all resource types and instead be limited to request and event resource types. The resolution also called for a note explaining why decision support use cases need request resources so provider/user interaction can be part of clinical reasoning results.
initial_application: SVN 14275, represented in git as 3c199cb8638fa383fa2b344eb2840db4361d49b5, applied the seed by changing ActivityDefinitionKind in source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-spreadsheet.xml from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/resource-types to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-resource-types and by adding source/terminologies/valueset-event-or-request-resource-types.xml. A later same-day cleanup commit, a9e864411da546587c04fd29516a8083a18d9f6e, carried the same issue subject while preserving the request-resource-types binding.
additional_context: The current build-scope ActivityDefinition source is active through source/fhir.ini and now lives in source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml. It binds ActivityDefinition.kind, with required strength, to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-resource-types and documents that only Request resource types may be specified. Later Published issue FHIR-29209 clarified how clinical reasoning should generate event resources: use Task with focus set to the event resource. Commit 5126624496f45455a6dbaf65bfc5c7d44f4f367e applied that guidance to ActivityDefinition.kind, and FHIR Workflow minutes record the same Task-based expectation. FHIR-29209 is already represented on the combined branch, so it was not decided again.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source is no longer too loose: it is stricter than the literal seed wording and matches the later approved Task-based event-resource guidance. Changing ActivityDefinition.kind to the event-or-request value set would reintroduce event resources contrary to the later FHIR-29209 decision.

related_jiras.note: Published CDS issue that clarified event resources should be produced through Task guidance rather than allowed directly in ActivityDefinition.kind; already audited on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring ActivityDefinition.kind to be tightened from all resource types and documenting the request-resource rationale.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed issue's final status, requested artifact, and rationale for limiting the binding.

evidence_items.summary: ActivityDefinition.kind has a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-resource-types and a request-only comment with Task guidance for events.
evidence_items.learned: The current active source is not too loose and should not be changed to allow event resources directly.

evidence_items.summary: SVN 14275 implementation for GF#15872 changed ActivityDefinitionKind from resource-types to request-resource-types and added the event-or-request value set.
evidence_items.learned: The historical application narrowed the ActivityDefinition.kind binding to request resources rather than leaving it broadly bound.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue on how clinical reasoning can generate event resources, resolved with guidance to use Task for event-resource output.
evidence_items.learned: This later decision explains and supersedes the literal event-resource allowance implied by FHIR-15872.

evidence_items.summary: J#29209 source commit rewrote ActivityDefinition.kind documentation to say only Request resource types are permitted and to use Task.focus for events.
evidence_items.learned: The current request-only wording is intentional later source history, not an accidental omission from FHIR-15872.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR Workflow minutes for FHIR-29209 say the result is expected to always be a Task saying to store the Observation because the response is a Request proposal.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports the later Task-based event-resource interpretation.
